svg.title: Large-ship routes ring Puerto Rico and run through the Mona and Anegada passages; 7 of 8 ports sit on them

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship routes ring Puerto Rico and run through the Mona and Anegada passages; 7 of 8 ports sit on them
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Blue route cells ring Puerto Rico, cross the Mona Passage to the west and the Anegada Passage to the east, and reach San Juan, Ponce, Guaynabo, Yabucoa, Charlotte Amalie, Limetree Bay, Frederiksted.
